title: af/task-collected-inspection@3
description: What `af task show --json` prints for a Task `af task gc --apply` collected (ADR-0135), in place of the artifact-backed `af/task-inspection@14`: the Task's ID, the finished phase its log recorded, and its retained tombstone. No artifact is read to produce it. Version 2 adds the `state` `af task list` prints for it: finished, the outcome its tombstone retained, cause `collected`. Version 3: its Task state is task-state version 2, whose causes add `provider_environment` (provider_failed) and `attempt_wall` (exhausted) (ADR-0257); the previous version is neither printed nor read.
